Commentary.Commentary: Virat Kohli's century and Nathan Lyon's fifer would be the highlights of this innings. The Indian skipper battled fire with fire and scored his 25th ton. For the Aussies, Lyon got yet another five-for and wrapped up the tail quickly once the main batsmen departed. So, Australia will essentially start from 43/0 and it means that India will have to bowl really well to restrict the hosts to a total that will be possible to reach in the second essay. As for the hosts, they have a brilliant chance to get the series back on parity. They will look to bat smart and set a total out of reach for the Indians, while also having enough overs to bowl them out. Join us for the Australian second innings in a bit...

That's that and the hosts have a lead of 43 runs which is quite handy on this surface. It was again an innings dominated by one man mainly with a few others playing good knocks around him. To put it into perspective, India lost their last 7 wickets for 110, last 6 wickets for 60 and last 5 for just 32. Their tail hasn't managed to add much once again and they have given up a quite substantial lead.

OUT! Gone next ball. 14th Test fifer for Nathan Lyon, 7th against India. What a bowler! What an extraordinary bowler! Tossed up ball landing outside off, Bumrah gets back inside the crease to defend it with the spin. But it doesn't turn back in enough and takes the outside edge. Khawaja at first slip reacts quickly to his left and grabs a fine catch. All over for India in this innings, they are all out for 283!

FOUR! Is that dropped? Maybe. But that was travelling with the speed of light. Full and around off, Bumrah gives it the full whack of his bat and hammers it right back at the bowler. Lyon jumps to attempt the return catch but it quickly goes past him to the fence behind.
Full and flighted outside off, going straight on, Jasprit draws forward to defend but is beaten. Paine collects and breaks the stumps quickly but nothing doing.
Sharp spin from outside off, Bumrah presses forward to defend but it sneaks past the outside edge and Paine collects it over the stumps.
Jasprit Bumrah is the last batsman.

OUT! Pant has holed out! End of a decent hand but he's dejected. Lyon flights it generously outside off, Pant attempts for a big one down the ground but doesn't connect well. It goes to long on and Mitchell Starc takes a smart catch diving forward. Fourth wicket for the off spinner. Pant had to go for it if the visitors had to reach anywhere near the first innings total of the hosts. Unfortunately for him, it doesn't go the distance. India trail by 47 runs.
A length delivery on the pads, Umesh clips it straight towards backward square leg.
The line is too straight this time and Pant just uses the pace of the bowler to help it on its way to fine leg. A single taken.
Beaten! Not for the first time, Pant is beaten. Mitchell Starc is in good rhythm at the moment. Hurls one around off, whizzing off the surface at 145.5 kph, Pant pokes inside the line and misses.
Targets the rib cage with a thundering short delivery at 148.3 kph, Umesh does well to move inside the line as he deflects it down to fine leg for a run.
Goes searching for a yorker but ends up serving a low full toss, Pant flicks it through mid-wicket for a run. Deficit is under 50 now.
Play and a miss! Starc delivers a shortish ball outside off, Pant goes for big hoick across the line but misses the ball completely. Lost his shape there, Rishabh.
Outside off and Umesh takes a big stride as he defends this one into the ground.
Slower through the air this time, Yadav comes ahead and dead-bats it.
This is really quick outside off, Umesh is very late on his defense and misses the ball.
Play and miss! Yadav comes ahead to defend but the ball beats his outside edge.
Outside off, Umesh keeps it out on the front foot.
JUST SHORT! This is flatter from Lyon, Pant smashes it over mid on for a single. The fielder at long on did not have enough time to come in and decides it is better to save the boundary.
Lucky, Umesh is very lucky. His reflexes are working fine at the moment. Starc spears in a 151.4 kph yorker on off, Umesh has his bat down in time to block it.
Touches 150 kph again. Starc nearly hits the yorker mark and Pant digs it out down to mid on for one.
Width on offer outside off, this time Pant connects with his attempted square cut and the ball travels in the deep. A couple taken.
Beaten, Pant this time. Starc dishes out a length delivery outside off, at 146.5 kph, Pant tries to force it through the line but is beaten for pace.

Nearly a catch at short leg! 149.3 kph, reads the speedgun. Starc is breathing fire. Bangs in a short ball on middle, Umesh fends at it awkwardly and somehow plays it out on the leg side. It's uppish and goes quickly past the outstretched right hand of the short leg fielder. A single taken.
Fast and furious. At 147 kph, Starc delivers a shortish ball just around off, Umesh defends it by nearly taking his eyes off the ball.
Well outside off again, Rishabh is not drawn into a shot and lets it go.
Outside off and spins away, left alone by Pant.
This is flatter outside off and it's pushed to cover. Pant wants the single but is sent back wisely.

SIX! This one goes into the stands. Generously looped up outside off, Pant dances down the track and lofts it over long on for a maximum. It was against the spin and risky but it was off the middle of the bat and carried all the way.
Short ball outside off, defended off the back foot to mid off.
FOUR! Pant decides enough is enough and goes for the pick up shot over mid-wicket. A fielder is there in the deep but it is away from him and the ball reaches the fence.

Starc bowls fire! Clocks 151.9 kph and hurls it very full on off, Yadav is lucky that his bat comes down in time to dig it out. Good testing over for the number 10. Pant should look to face more balls from here on. India trail by 65 runs.
Digs in a shortish ball on middle, Yadav does just enough to block it from the back foot. There is a short leg waiting for anything to pop out.
On a good length this time, around off, Yadav waits for it on the back foot and taps it down to covers.
Not exactly a yorker but it's speared in around off, very full, Umesh does well to keep it out safely at mid-wicket.
Starc switches to 'round the wicket and lets out a back of a length delivery outside off. Yadav sticks back to push inside the line but misses. Probably setting him up for a big inswinging yorker.
Speeds in and serves a length delivery outside off, Pant throws his bat at it and slices his attempted cover drive behind point. A single taken, strangely. Umesh is now exposed to Starc.
Mitchell Starc is back on.
This is defended well by the tailender to end the 100th over.
Yadav fails to put bat on ball this time as he looks to defend this ball well outside off.
Goes for the big slog this time and fails to connect on this arm ball. The ball goes to the keeper and Paine appeals for a catch but the umpire in unmoved.
Another ball outside off and flatter, defended back to mid off.
Woahhh! That one holds its line and bounces a lot. Yadav is ahead in defense and misses the ball completely.
Flatter ball outside off, Yadav stands tall and pushes it to mid off.
Fuller and outside off again, seems like a definite plan. Pant wants to drive this but misses the ball again.
Another one outside off, Rishabh misses his cut again.

Doesn't hold back on this occasion. Goes for the cut and gets it to the right of deep point. The fielder cleans up but throws well wide at the non-striker's end, allowing for an extra run on the overthrow. Pant gets back on strike.
Wide outside again, the southpaw lets it go.
A similar delivery and Pant decides not to play at it this time.
Outside off and going away, Pant goes for the slog down the ground but misses it completely.
Flat again outside off, Umesh manages to keep it out by coming ahead.
Flatter on middle and leg, Pant nudges it away towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Quicker and fuller on off, Umesh sweeps it behind square leg for a run.
Tossed up ball around off, Yadav prods forward and defends it from the outer half of his bat to silly point.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Turn and bounce from outside off. Umesh lunges to defend but it whizzes past the outside edge. A good take by Paine.
This one is short outside off and hurries onto Pant as he tries to pull it. The ball goes off the inner half of the willow and right back to mid off.
Pant goes for a wild swipe and misses the ball outside off completely.
Short delivery aimed at the body, Yadav does well to fend it off on the leg side. The batsmen run through for a single.
This delivery is outside off, Pant plays it away to deep point for a single.
Well outside off on a short length, left alone by Rishabh.

DROPPED! These catches are very difficult to pull off, especially in the followthrough. Cummins serves a good length delivery on middle, Pant goes for a full-blooded shot back down the ground. It is straight back at the bowler on the full but is too fast for Pat to hold on. He gets his hands to it but unfortunately the ball doesn't stick. Would've been disaster for the visitors had Cummins held on.
Another loopy one on middle, Yadav defends it into the ground again.
Slower through the air this time, defended with soft hands and into the ground.
Quicker at the pads, Yadav pushes it to mid-wicket.
Flatter ball outside off, Umesh defends it back to the bowler.
Umesh Yadav walks in next.

OUT! Caught and bowled! Third wicket for Lyon. A flighted delivery landing around off and turning back in. Ishant gets forward with the intention to play a firm drive but his bat turns in his hands. He ends up chipping it back to the bowler and Lyon is a superlative fielder off his own bowling. Accepts the catch gleefully with a tumble. A sorry shot by Ishant. All they need is to partner Pant out there.
Looped outside off, Ishant tries playing it straight but it goes off the inside half to mid on.
Another half-tracker from Cummins, Ishant somehow manages to play it away on the leg side for a run.
Short length ball again on middle, Ishant pushes it back to the bowler.
OUCH! The ball is fast and hits Ishant on his back as he tries to evade this short-pitched delivery at the body.
Outside off on a short length, Ishant defends it well.
Outside off and Ishant fends it on the off side. The batsmen want a quick single but the ball goes straight to the fielder.
Well outside off, Pant cuts it away to deep point for a run. The Aussies are content in letting Pant get to the other end.
Pat Cummins to bowl from the other end.
Beaten outside off, flatter delivery and Ishant tries to defend off the back foot but misses.
Another flatter ball outside off, Ishant comes ahead and defends it well.
Well kept out by Sharma once more.
Outside off and defended on the front foot by Ishant.
... DAY 3, SESSION 2 ... The players and umpires are back for the 2nd session. Nathan Lyon to continue from the 3rd ball of his over. Ishant Sharma is the new batsman for India and will be on strike.

Australia have stormed their way into the match and the ball now lies firmly in their court. It is up to Pant to farm the strike and take the visitors as close to the Aussie total as possible. Will it happen or not? We will know in the post-Lunch session. Join us in a short while for the same.

80 runs and 4 wickets. Surely Australia's session after the last three balls. India have lost four wickets in the session, including the all-important one of Virat Kohli. The morning session began with the loss of Rahane on the fourth ball of the day. He was replaced by Hanuma Vihari who looked good during his stay and scored 20 but more importantly was involved in a handy partnership with his captain. A peach of a delivery by Hazlewood removed him and then the Indian keeper, Rishabh Pant came in next. He along with his captain looked set to take their team into the lunch break unscathed but that was not to be as Pat Cummins dismissed the Indian skipper minutes before the break.

OUT! Just as we thought so. Another one bites the dust. That's the fourth in this session and the match has turned on its head here. Shami gone for a golden duck. Plenty of turn and bounce. It's served outside off by Lyon, Shami comes ahead to defend but gets a feather behind to the keeper. It is collected beautifully by Paine as he jumps in appeal. The finger has gone up. That's too good for a tailender. THAT WILL ALSO BE LUNCH ON DAY 3 AND AUSTRALIA LEAD BY 74 RUNS.
Shorter outside off, Pant pushes it away to sweeper cover for a single. Not sure that's the best thing to do with a tailender at the other end.
Mohammed Shami is the next batsman to the crease.

OUT! Massive moment in this match. Virat Kohli is walking off the field with India still trailing by 75 runs. Cummins pitches it up and around off to invite yet another drive from the Indian skipper. Virat obliges as he gets forward to stroke it through covers. But this time his front foot is not exactly to the pitch of the delivery and he ends up edging it behind. Peter Handscomb standing at second slip goes down low to his right and takes the catch inches above the surface. He immediately gets up claiming the catch but Kohli is not going anywhere. The two umpires get together and then refer it upstairs. Soft signal is out. The replays roll in and it's touch and go. One angle shows that Peter's fingers are under the ball. There ain't much conclusive evidence though. The third umpire goes with the soft signal. That brings an end to an outstanding knock by the Indian captain. He heads back amidst a big cheer from the crowd.

Edged and taken! Has that carried? Peter Handscomb is claiming it but Virat Kohli is not going anywhere. The two umpires get together and then refer it upstairs. Not sure what the soft signal is as when Kumar Dharmasena signals for it his back was to the camera. We're hearing that he reckons that it carried. Let's see...
Another delivery in the channel outside off, Kohli is very watchful as he sees the line closely and then leaves it alone.
Bowls this one closer to the off stump line but it's not close enough to bother the Indian skipper.
In the region outside off, holding its line, Kohli shoulders arms.

Edged but safe! Cummins once again angles across a delivery, it's on the fuller side this time and Pant is lured into the drive. He however fails to middle his shot properly and the ball rushes off the outside edge to third man. A single taken.
Angles across a length delivery around off, Pant is quite compact in his defense.
Tossed up ball on off, blocked back off the front foot.
Loopy and full outside off, yet another cracking drive from the bat of Kohli but this time it goes straight to mid off.
Another delivery which is a bit on the shorter side around off, Kohli defends it off his back foot again.
Lyon pulls his length back a bit and delivers it around off, Virat goes on the back foot and defends it.

FOUR! Gives respect to the bowler on the first ball and then dismisses the next one. Lyon serves another flighted full ball outside off, Kohli gets forward with a big stride and crunches his drive through covers for a boundary.
Nicely tossed up delivery around off, an off spinner, Virat lunges and defends it watchfully.
Nathan Lyon comes back for another spell.
Shorter outside off stump, Virat pushes it off his back foot to the left of point for a single. Keeps the strike.
Well outside off, Kohli keeps it out towards point.
Lands on off and nips in late to beat the inside edge of Virat's bat. Catches him on the back thigh but there is no appeal as the ball is too high.
Well down leg again, Kohli wants to work it away but misses the ball.
Oooh! Pant goes for the drive to this full one outside off but gets the inside edge that runs to square leg. The batsmen get a single.
Outside off on a short length, Kohli keeps it out on the off side and runs through for a single.
Pat Cummins into the attack.
Bouncer, Pant just ducks under it to end the 90th over.

FOUR! A genuine outside edge has been induced from Josh coming around the wicket. Pant was looking to drive but the ball moves away a little to get the outside edge. It runs in the gap between slips and gully for a boundary.
Another one outside off, Kohli pushes this ball through the gap for a run.
Well outside off from Josh, Kohli leans into the defense.
Full outside off, Kohli times the drive beautifully but Finch at cover dives to his weaker side and stops the ball. Surely saved some runs there.
Outside off, Pant leans into the drive and pushes it to covers for a run.
Second miscue from the skipper in this over. Bouncer aimed at the batsman is not controlled well and it almost carries to point. Starc can't believe Kohli's luck here.
Fuller on middle, Pant works it away nicely through the gap in the mid-wicket region. The ball doesn't have the legs to reach the fence but an easy three.
Better from the skipper as he leans into his push to covers for a single.
Good ball! On a length and slides along with the angle. Virat was looking to defend but the ball caught him on the top of the willow. It went on the bounce to the slips.
Angling down at the pads, flicked away to fine leg for a run.
Starc serves it outside off, Pant lets this one go in the nick of time.
A bumper going down leg, Kohli looks to pull but misses the ball completely. Paine collects the ball and appeals but there is nothing on it.
Shorter on middle, the southpaw nudges it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
A length ball outside off, Pant hangs back in the crease and keeps it out.
Straighter ball on middle and leg, Rishabh defends it coming slightly forward.
On a length outside off, Pant comes ahead to defend to cover.
Shorter length outside off stump, Kohli defends it towards cover-point and gets to the other end.
BEATEN! Outside off from Starc, Pant comes ahead to defend but misses the ball. Lucky not to get the outside edge.
Short and pacy delivery on middle and leg, Kohli fends it off uncomfortably towards the leg side. The batsmen get a quick single.
Fuller ball that is angling down leg, Rishabh tries to flick it but gets the inner half of the bat and the ball runs to fine leg for a run.
Outside off on a length, Pant defends it on the back foot towards cover.

FOUR BYES! Freebies for India. Starc pitches this very short, wanting to serve a welcome to Pant. The ball though rises too high as Pant just sways out of the way and it is very high for even a jumping Paine to get a hand to it. It goes and hits the fence behind him within seconds. The trail is under 100 now.
Shorter outside off, Kohli angles it away to deep point for a run.
Good length ball outside off, Pant is forward to defend this one. It goes off the outside half of the bat to gully.
Another ball outside off and on the shorter side, Rishabh is on his toes and keeps it out.
Short outside off to start off, Pant stands tall and defends.
Rishabh Pant is the new batsman in.

OUT! What a beautiful delivery from Hazlewood. He has deserved a wicket! Beaten the bat on multiple occasions and finally gets the reward. Serves this one on a length and outside off. Gets the ball to nip off the pitch and it straightens after landing. Vihari, who is on the back foot, tries to defend but gets the slightest of edges. It carries to Paine at a good height. A very good ball that, would get most batsmen out. End of a decent innings, a good 50-run stand with his captain. India still trail by 103 runs.
Shorter outside off, played towards point but no run.
Outside off and left alone by Hanuma. He had some attention from the physio during the time between the overs.
Pushes the ball up a bit, on the pads and Vihari keeps strike with a flicked single to square leg. Brings up the 50-run stand between these two.
Defends this short one from within the crease.
Another brilliant adjustment from the batsman to a short ball aimed at the head. Slightly moves outside the line of the ball and guides it down to third man with very gentle hands while on his toes.
Short length ball and aimed at the batsman. Very awkward height for VK but he adjusts well, taking his bottom hand off the willow and controls the ball, making sure it won't have pace on it.
Length ball outside off, Virat comes ahead and tries to push it on the off side but the ball comes off the inner half of the bat and goes towards mid-wicket.
Short pitched delivery, defended by Hanuma on the back foot into the leg side. The batsmen switch ends.
Left alone outside the off stump.
Peach to respond! Served outside off and straightens in the end. Kohli, who was looking to defend it, has a puzzled look on his face as he misses it. Flies through to the keeper.

SIX! That has just flown off the bat and all the way for six runs. Short outside off and Kohli flashes hard at it. There is extra bounce and it takes the top half of the bat and flies over the rope. No fielder there anyway so it was a safe option. He completes 5000 Test runs batting at number 4 in 86 innings, fastest to do so. Yet another record tumbles in front of him.
Fuller length outside off, Virat comes well ahead and defends it into the ground.
Wider of the crease, delivered outside off. Left alone by Kohli.
On a length and outside off, Kohli finds the middle of the bat yet again as he drives to mid off.

Drinks break. Another entertaining hour of play. Kohli hasn't let the early jolt today affect him and reached his 25th ton in Tests. Hanuma at the other end, has batted confidently. The new ball is only 3 overs old and we haven't seen much swing so far. The next hour can have a lot of say in the game.
Fuller on middle and the ball is defended straight back to mid on. There isn't much swing here with the new ball so far.
On a length outside off, Kohli trudges ahead and drops it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Responds with a bouncer aimed at the head, Kohli ducks under it at the last moment. Paine does well to get a hand to it and save it from going for four byes.
FOUR! Typical Kohli. Overpitched outside off from the left-arm seamer, Virat is on one knee and just pushes it solidly through the covers for four. Holds the pose too.
Shorter length delivery outside off, VK raises his arms and lets it go.
Bowled wide outside off by Starc, Kohli shoulders his arms to it.
Goes wide of the crease this time, well outside off, left alone by the right-hander.
Shortens the length a little, Vihari gets on top of the ball and keeps it down.
Similar ball outside off, leaves it alone this time.
Peach from Josh! Serves it outside off, Vihari looks to defend as the ball tails away in the end to beat the outside edge.
Drifting onto the pads, flicked away towards deep backward square leg for an easy two.
Length ball on off, Hanuma defends solidly.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl from the other end with the new cherry.
Starc slants it across the batsman, Kohli plays it down with the angle and it comes off the outer half of his blade. Soft hands there. Rolling towards gully.
Another watchful leave outside the off stump by the Indian captain.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, it's left alone.
Play and a miss! Loss in concentration probably. Starc serves it full and outside off, Kohli is beaten on the drive.

FOUR! Here it is, century number 25 in Tests for Virat Kohli! The talisman of India's batting reaches the milestone with a lovely shot down the ground through mid off. It's pitched up around off and is met with great timing and placement. A knock under testing conditions from the Indian skipper. Off comes the helmet and Kohli celebrates. He has a determined look on his face. The job is not done yet and Virat is aware of it. Some interesting stats - Kohli is the second quickest to complete 25 Test tons, taking 127 innings, only behind Sir Don Bradman (68). Also, he has equaled Sachin Tendulkar for most hundreds by an Indian batsman in Australia (6). Take a bow, Mr. Run Machine!
Starts the new spell with a fuller length ball around off, Kohli leans forward and across before helping it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Second new ball has been taken by Australia. Mitchell Starc returns...
Fuller outside off, defended into the ground by Hanuma.

Outside off, Kohli dabs it with soft hands and sets off for a quick single. The ball goes straight to Travis Head at covers who has a shy at the striker's end. Vihari is quick to respond but he would have been a goner had the ball hit the stumps. Needless from the Indians.
Shorter length this time, straightens after landing. Kohli rocks back and closes his bat too early as he tries to work it on the leg side. Gets a leading edge that goes to backward point. Very lucky!

FOUR! Very wide outside off, Kohli drives hard and finds the gap through the covers. The ball goes to the fence and the Indian captain is into the 90s. Also brings up the 200 for the visitors. They trail by 126 runs now.
Overpitched, Virat pushes it wristily back to the bowler.
Flatter outside off, Kohli comes ahead and pushes it to backward point.
Another short ball aimed at the head, Hanuma looks like he has taken his eyes off it as he tries to fend it. Lucky for him that it doesn't take the gloves and pop out to short leg.
Predictable comeback from Pat. Goes for the bouncer, Vihari ducks under it.
FOUR! Sounds good and is good. Fuller length and he latches onto it instantly. Drives confidently through mid off and all the way for four runs.
Bouncer, well above the head of Hanuma who lets it go.
Gets it this time as he drops it on the off side and sets off.
Slightly short of a length outside off, Kohli defends on the back foot. Looks for the quick single but then decides against it.
Another looped one outside off, Vihari defends with soft hands towards slip.
Comes ahead to this one and pushes it to mid-wicket.
Flatter on middle, Vihari stands in his crease and keeps it out.
Much shorter to Kohli, he goes back in his crease and works it away towards square leg and sets off for a quick single. His partner is quick to respond and makes it in time.
Fuller this time, Hanuma drives to long on for a run.
Drifted outside off, Vihari takes a big stride and defends it to mid-wicket.
Bouncer to the captain, he ducks under it.
Given some room outside off, the batsman opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third man for a single.
Shorter outside off, Hanuma goes well back in his crease to keep it out.

Fuller and coming in after landing, Kohli comes forward and turns it into the leg side for a single. Marcus Harris, who is at deep square leg, falls down while picking it up and feels his hammy after throwing. Doesn't look like it's anything too serious though.
Back to a good length, left alone by Virat this time.
Short and outside off, Kohli climbs on top of the bounce and keeps it down.
Slightly ahead to end the over, Hanuma comes forward to defend. The ball turns a bit and gets the inner half of the bat. Luckily for the batsman, it doesn't carry to short leg.
Shorter outside off and turning in, Vihari rocks back and tries to work it on the leg side. Finds short leg.
Fuller one on off and middle, Vihari is forward in defense.
Well outside off, left alone.
Slightly pitched up, Hanuma comes forward and defends to mid-wicket.
Flatter ball outside off, Vihari stands tall and defends it.
Bouncer from Pat to end the over, Kohli lets it fly over his head.
Good looking shot down the ground to a fuller one outside off. The batsmen pick up three as a widish mid off fielder gives chase.
Length delivery on top of off stump, he takes a good stride forward and defends it to mid-wicket.
Effort ball from Cummins, Vihari just ducks under it and lets it go.
Good quick delivery on middle, Hanuma is back in his crease and defends.
Good length ball on top of the off stump line to start, Vihari is watchful in defense.
Pat Cummins now into the attack.
Similar ball to end the over and Virat pushes it to mid-wicket again. Tidy stuff by Nathan.
Flatter ball on middle, Kohli pushes it to short mid-wicket.
Fired in at the pads, flicked away wristily by Hanuma for a run to deep mid-wicket.
Another flatter delivery on off, Vihari dead-bats it.
Back to the line outside off, Hanuma is ahead and defends it into the ground.
Looped up but well down the leg side, Vihari looks to flick but misses the ball.
Nathan Lyon is back.
Well down the leg side, was it a planned ball? Kohli looks to flick it away but misses. Hanuma, the new batsman, will be on strike in the next over.
Shorter outside off, Kohli plays a good looking shot to the right of third man. The batsmen come back for two by the time Lyon cleans up near the boundary rope.
Aimed at the batsman's body, Virat fends it away towards mid-wicket.
Short again and Kohli gauges the bounce on the ball and shoulders his arms to this one.
Short again and this one cuts in after landing, Kohli is cramped for space and keeps it out awkwardly.
Short and wide outside off, Vihari cuts similarly to his boundary in the previous over. There is a third man present this time who keeps it down to one.
Good length ball outside off, Virat keeps it out by coming half-ahead.
Fuller length, Kohli is on the front foot and pushes it towards mid on.
Shortens the length a bit on this occasion, the skipper is immediately on to the back foot and defends.
Good length ball just outside off, Kohli takes a stride ahead and defends it into the ground.
Drifting onto the pads this time, Kohli tucks it away on the leg side towards mid-wicket.
Short and on off stump to start with, Kohli hangs back and defends it.
Interesting bowling change. Nathan Lyon has been removed after a successful first over. Pat Cummins is unleashed. Thinking on his feet, Tim Paine.
Another bouncer to end the over, Vihari lets it go over his head again.
Bouncer to follow up, just a typical fast bowler's response. Vihari ducks under it.

FOUR! Short and well outside off, Vihari hangs his bat out and middles his shot properly. The ball rushes away to the left of point all the way for four runs. This must give the youngster a lot of confidence.
Good length ball outside off, defended by Hanuma from within the crease.

OUCH! This one is aimed at the body and hurries on to Kohli who was lining up the pull. He has to take evasive action and gets hit on the elbow. The ball goes to fine leg and the batsmen cross. Leg byes signaled.
Short outside off to start with, left alone by Kohli.
Mitchell Starc to bowl from the other end. Two slips and a gully in place.
A quick single to end the over. Shorter in length, Kohli rocks back and works it away to fine leg and keeps strike.
Off the mark straightaway, full and on middle, Hanuma flicks it away to mid-wicket for a single.
Hanuma Vihari arrives early in the morning.

OUT! Brilliant from Lyon! Even better from Paine! The fourth Indian wicket falls off the fourth ball of the day. Just the start the Aussies would've liked. This one is slightly shorter than the previous one, but Rahane is drawn forward in defense. The ball drifts and straightens a bit with the breeze and gets the faintest of edges. Tim makes no mistake behind the wickets and breaks the stumps as well before beginning his celebration. The finger is up for a caught behind and the Indian vice-captain has to depart without adding any run to his overnight score. This is the 8th time Lyon has hunted down Ajinkya in Tests. Making him his bunny. The deficit for the tourists is still in excess of 150.
Looped up outside off, Rahane comes ahead and defends.
First run of the day as Kohli pushes it to deep mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Starts off with a quicker ball outside off, Kohli goes back in his crease and defends to mid-wicket.

The players and the umpires are out in the middle. Virat Kohli will take strike on the first ball of the day to be bowled by surprise surprise, Nathan Lyon. Maybe, the Aussies want to bowl the next 11 overs quickly and get the second new ball. Let's play...

Nathan Lyon in an interview with Mark Howard says that the rain didn't help their cause yesterday and the pitch held up well. Hopes that he will get more help today. Talking about his batting, he says it is amazing to have a cricket coach in his brother who has helped him a lot with it. Coming up to the pitch, he has a look and says that the rain caused the ball to skid on except for a ball on Day 2 which Kohli left alone and that spun a long way with extra bounce. States that he will be looking to bowl more of the same. About Kohli's wicket, he feels that the Indian skipper is one of the best in the world, but adds that he will be looking to get him out as soon as possible. Finishes off by saying that he will try to use the breeze to get some drift and get some close-in catches.

Pitch report - Michael Vaughan says the surface surprised them all yesterday by playing so well. Adds that the cracks have opened up a bit today and should help Lyon while bowling from the Justin Langer End. Signs off by saying that we have had riveting cricket for two days and it should be a belter today as well.

For the visitors, Kohli and Rahane will be expected to take India as close to the home team's first innings total as possible. Any lead will come in handy as it won't be easy batting fourth on this wicket. Most probably, by the end of today, we should have a fair idea of which way this Test is heading. It will be an engrossing and hard-fought day, make no mistake. You don't want to miss this, stay with us. Action from Perth in just a bit.

Welcome to Day 3 of the second Test of the Border-Gavaskar trophy. We have had two days of intense cricketing action. The match seems to be evenly poised at the moment. What has been the difference over the two days though is the weather - The sun was out on Day 1 and it was cloudy on the following day. The forecast for today is for the sun to make a comeback and remain throughout the day. Coming to this Test match, the hosts, who are ahead by 154 runs as of now, would look to snipe out this already 90-run unbeaten partnership as soon as they can, and that will provide an opening into the Indian lower order which doesn't inspire much confidence.
... Day 3, Session 1 ...

So then, Kohli and Rahane are unbeaten at Stumps and both should look to go on to make it count. From the hosts' point of view, they still have a handy lead of 154 runs and would look to grab either one of these or both early on Day 3. Should be really fun to watch. Action will resume at 1020 local (0220 GMT). Do join us then. Take care!

One thing that Australia would be happy about is the fact that there haven't been any free runs or loose runs given. Everything has been hard-earned and the Indians have not been let off the hook. The day was mostly played under cloudy weather and the cracks on the pitch seemed to have closed as the ball didn't misbehave as much as it did on Day 1. Earlier this morning, the Australian lower order added 49 runs to their overnight total to post 326 on the board. In reply, both the Indian openers were removed cheaply and it took really hard-fought knocks with lots of concentration from the next three batsmen to keep India afloat in this Test. They will be proud of what they have achieved so far.

What a fight it has been from India! Not many would have given them a chance on this wicket. They end Day 2 on 172/3 after being 8/2 at one time. No doubt the pitch has played a lot better than it did yesterday but take nothing away from the skill and patience of Pujara, Kohli and Rahane. The third session started with the loss of the new 'Wall' of the Indian team, Cheteshwar Pujara. It looked gloomy and one thought that the horrors of the  Adelaide Test's first innings would resurface. But Rahane and Virat have batted beautifully and both reached their fifties during the course of their unbeaten 90-run stand. The Aussie bowling looked somewhat less lethal and run-scoring became easy after a certain period. The short ball ploy against the Indian vice-captain didn't work out and Nathan Lyon, even though economical, wasn't too effective.

A rising delivery, around middle and leg, Rahane gets across and taps it down in the mid-wicket region. Looks for a run but Kohli turns it down as Cummins runs across to his right to stop the ball. That will be Stumps on Day 2.
Lands it on a good length around off, Ajinkya goes on his toes and defends it back solidly.
A bouncer is served on the plate for Rahane. It's around off and he sways away from the line.
The line is very straight this time and Virat clips it off his pads in front of square leg for three runs.

Edged but safe! Soft hands from Kohli keeps it all along the ground. An excellent delivery by Cummins. Probes with a length ball around off and gets it to straighten. Kohli plays inside the line and gets an outside edge. It rolls in front of wide first slip.
Good length delivery just outside off, Kohli rises on his back foot and plays it down safely to the off side.
Flatter delivery which is slightly shorter, Rahane remains in the crease and defends it back down the ground.
Front foot defense from Jinx to keep the fuller one out.
Oooh! This one rips a little more than many and the ball takes the inside half of Rahane's bat who was trying to defend. Luckily, the ball goes onto the pads and just falls down on the pitch.
Lyon flights this one outside off, Rahane comes well ahead and dead-bats this.
Fuller this time, Kohli prods ahead and pushes it through mid-wicket for a run.
Short ball on the pads, Rahane works it away on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Just as we say it was a good over, it is spoilt by a poor delivery on the hips. Easily worked away fine on the leg side for a boundary. The trail is cut down to 159 runs now.

BEATEN! After a long time, a good length ball on off stump straightens and beats the outside edge of Virat who was looking to defend. This over has been a really good one considering that it is at the fag end of the day.
Full and on middle, driven to mid on off the front foot by the skipper.
Another one outside off, good probing line from Cummins in this over. Kohli plays it with soft hands to point.
Flicked away off his hips but straight to the square leg fielder.
Outside off on a short length, Virat climbs on top of the bounce and defends the ball.
Pat Cummins replaces Hazlewood.
Well outside off, left alone by Ajinkya.
Flighted ball outside off and finally some good turn for Lyon. The ball takes the inside edge onto the pads. Good ball.
Driven straight back to the bowler this time, slightly in the air but safe.
Full and pushed down to long on for yet another single by VK.

FIFTY for the INDIAN VICE-CAPTAIN! His 17th in Tests. It is also his third fifty in the last three Tests. A delivery outside off and on the fuller side, Rahane drives it through cover and gets to the other end. A very good knock in the situation. Needed it as he was replacing Pujara at the crease.
Full and outside off, Kohli pushes it down the ground wide of long on for a single.
Nathan Lyon changes ends.
Another overpitched delivery and another gorgeous drive. This time from the skipper. Finds the gap on the offside and the batsmen pick up three. Kohli is back on strike for the next over.
Short outside off, left alone by VK.
Full and outside again, Rahane pushes it to the deepish mid off region and gets to the other end. 49 for Jinx.
FOUR! Overcompensates on this occasion as he goes short and wide outside off. Rahane rocks back and cuts it over backward point for another four. Consecutive boundaries. Moves to 48!

FOUR! Glorious would be the word here. The ball goes as straight as an arrow down the ground. Lucky not to have hit the stumps at the non-striker's end. Lovely to watch and four runs. You cannot afford to overpitch to this batsman.
Full and outside off, Rahane is forward as he leans into his drive back to the bowler.
Josh Hazlewood is back into the attack. Should be a 3-over burst for him.
Outside off and short of a good length, Kohli shoulders his arms. 5 overs left in the day now.
Another bouncer on middle and leg, Kohli ducks under it.
Short ball on middle, Rahane swipes across the line but along the ground. It goes to deep square leg for a run.
Good length delivery and on top of middle and leg, Rahane stands tall and defends it back to the bowler.
Outside off, left alone by Ajinkya.
Short ball on off stump, Rahane rises over the ball and plays it to point.
A single off the last ball and Rahane retains strike by playing the ball to long on.
Flicked away off the back foot but straight at the fielder.
Another dance down the track and Rahane almost guides it straight into short leg's hands. Just short. The fielder even throws it back to attempt a run out but Jinx is quick to get back in.
Rahane covers the spin on the loopy one and defends it into the ground.
Flatter delivery on middle and leg, he defends it into the ground on the leg side.
Flatter ball on middle, Jinx steps down the pitch and plays it to short mid-wicket.
Another full ball on the pads, Kohli drives it to the mid on fielder.
Very full, almost a half-volley. Virat drives it beautifully again but this time fails to find the gap. Straight to the cover fielder.
Bouncer on middle and leg, VK ducks underneath and evades it.
Another ball outside off, the skipper punches it but it is straight to the fielder.

FOUR! Makes batting look ridiculously easy. The ball is outside off and on a full length, slightly swinging away. Kohli leans into it and drives it wide of mid off and the ball is timed sweetly as it goes all the way for a boundary.
Outside off and left alone by Kohli.
Rahane comes ahead and keeps this out.
Flatter delivery on middle and leg, Jinx defends it on his back foot.
Fuller and quicker outside off, Rahane comes down the wicket and pushes it straight back down. Short mid-wicket dives to stop it and prevents a run.
Looped up on middle, Kohli works it away to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Flighted outside off, VK takes a large stride and dead-bats it.
Flatter delivery at the pads, Kohli works it to short mid-wicket.
Good length ball on off stump, Jinx is forward in defense.
Outside off on a length, Rahane lets it go through.
Drifting onto the pads, Kohli flicks it away to deep square leg for a single.
Outside off and left alone by the skipper.
Outside off and on a short length, Kohli leaves it alone. Surprise, surprise as this one doesn't even carry to the keeper.
Fuller and on middle, Kohli defends it back calmly to mid on.
Pat Cummins replaces Mitchell Starc.
Full ball on off, Rahane prods ahead and defends on the front foot.
Fuller on middle and off, Virat drives it down to long on for a run.
The arm ball on this occasion, the Indian skipper defends it solidly.
Flatter ball on middle, VK pushes it to short mid-wicket.
Flatter delivery outside off, Kohli comes ahead and dead-bats it.
Around the wicket and quicker, Kohli pushes it back to the bowler.
Wild ball from Starc, going well down leg. Rahane misses his shot and Paine collects it acrobatically down the leg side.
Similar to the third delivery of the over, Kohli also plays it away on the off side for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle and leg, Kohli defends it after covering the line of the ball.
Outside off and Rahane just nudges it on the off side in the gap and gets a quick single wide of mid off.
Shorter this time outside off, Rahane opens the face of the bat and tries to help it to the third man fence but the gully fielder dives to his left and stops it.
FOUR! Sublime and lovely to the eye! Full and outside off from Starc, Rahane takes a big step forward and creams it through the covers for a boundary.
Short ball, Kohli defends from within the crease.
Around the wicket, VK plays it with soft hands square on the leg side. No run.
Much better as he comes down the track and pushes it to long on to get to the non-striker's end.
Short and outside off, Rahane goes for the cut. Doesn't control it well but luckily for him, it does not carry to point's hand.
Flighted on off, Rahane takes a stride forward and plays it to short mid-wicket.
Full outside off, Rahane comes down the pitch and pushes it back to Lyon.
Drifting down on the pads with the angle, Rahane plays it delicately to fine leg and gets a single to retain strike. 50-run stand up between the captain and the vice-captain.
Good ball! Comes in with the angle, just on top of off stump. Rahane defends comfortably off the back foot.
Short again on off, Rahane climbs on top of the bounce and plays it down to point.
Short and wide outside off, Rahane lets the ball go to Tim behind the stumps.
Outside off, an easy single for Kohli as he pushes it to cover-point. Thinks about the second but decides against it.
Full and on the pads, Kohli pushes it to mid on with a straight bat.
Full and outside off, Rahane pushes it to cover.
Rahane comes ahead and dead-bats this loopy delivery outside off.
Another ball outside off that has been played with soft hands by Jinx to backward point.
Well outside off, Rahane watches it all the way into Paine's gloves. This one bounces a lot more than any of his recent deliveries.
Another flatter ball on off, Rahane keeps it out well.
Flighted outside off, Rahane takes a couple of steps before hitting it back to the bowler.
Left alone outside off. End of the over. Maiden.
Short of a length and on top of off stump, Kohli jumps onto his toes and defends it easily.
Fuller outside off, Kohli looks to drive it away but gets the inner half of the bat and the ball rolls straight back down the pitch.
A carbon copy of the previous ball.
Short and well outside off, Kohli raises his arms and lets it go.
The ball is on middle and leg, Kohli drives it back with a straight bat to mid on.
Starc is back for another spell.
Outside off and fuller this time, Rahane pushes it safely to cover to end the over.
Around the wicket to Kohli, he flicks it away and gets to the other end.
Rahane comes ahead and gets the inside half of the bat as the ball is full outside off. Runs to the left of short leg and the batsmen get a single.
Another ball that is on the off side, Rahane plays it into the ground after coming ahead.
Shorter ball on middle, Rahane stands back in his crease and pushes it to mid on.
Flatter ball outside off, Rahane is ahead and plays it with soft hands to point.
A dot ball to end the over as Kohli offers no shot to this short ball outside off.
Fuller outside off, Virat pushes it to the cover fielder.
FOUR! Very full and easy pickings for VK when he is at this stage of his innings. He just takes a stride forward and on drives this for a boundary.
Outside off and on a length, Kohli guides it along the ground to gully.
Short of a length and jags into Kohli. The skipper was looking to flick it away but misses and gets hit on rib cage.
Outside off and beaten! The ball lands on a length and beats Kohli's outside edge as he tries to push it through cover.
Covers the spin on the ball and plays it with soft hands to short leg to end the 51st over.
Flatter ball on middle and leg, Jinx is in his crease as he defends the ball into the ground.
Another full one outside off, Rahane pushes it straight to the fielder at extra cover this time.
Short and wide outside off, Rahane rocks back and cuts it but it goes straight to backward point.
Full and outside off, Rahane drives it to mid off.
Flatter delivery, flicked away off his pads by Kohli. Single taken.
Another full ball outside off, Rahane drives it and the ball makes a good sound off the bat. Starc at mid off though, dives to his left and prevents any run from being taken.
FOUR! Pulled away on the back foot. Rahane stands tall and pulls this short one square on the leg side and all the way to the fence. No one out there to stop it.

Good ball outside off, Rahane drops it down on the off side. His skipper on the other end wants a run but is rightfully sent back. Travis Head picks up the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses the throw. Kohli would have been just in had the ball hit, suggest the replays.
Fuller ball on off stump, Rahane presses ahead and pushes this one back to the bowler.
Short ball outside off, Rahane raises his hands and lets it go.
Good length ball outside off to start the over, Rahane plays it to gully with soft hands. Was looking to guide it in the gap maybe.
Shorter one to end the over, Kohli stands tall and defends this into the ground.
Flatter ball on off, Kohli takes a stride forward and defends it onto the leg side.
Flighted ball outside off, Rahane comes down the track and plays it wide of mid on for a run.
Quicker delivery on the middle stump, Rahane plays it to short leg on the bump.
Quicker ball on middle, Kohli works it away to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter delivery outside off, Kohli defends it from within the crease.

Drinks break has been taken. An enterprising hour of play from both sides. The Aussies would be happy to have seen the back of Pujara. Ajinkya Rahane who came in next has played his shots and scored at a brisk pace. His skipper reached his fifty and is looking good. The next hour of play will be a very crucial period of play. Who can come out trumps?

What happened there? The ball rares up from a good length and jags in after landing. Rahane is surprised as he looks to defend off the back foot. He does well to drop his bottom hand off the bat as the ball takes the top half of the blade and goes safely towards first slip.
Very full this time but outside off, left alone by Rahane. His fifth straight leave in a row.
Fuller in length outside off, Rahane takes a huge stride forward and lets it go.
Well outside off on a length, Jinx is disinterested and wants nothing to do with it.
Another short ball that is rising as it passes the batsman. Rahane shoulders his arms again.
Short ball outside off, left alone by Ajinkya.
Another one to which Rahane has his dancing shoes on. He then whips it away to deep mid-wicket for a single to keep strike.
Full and wide outside off, Kohli drives it through the covers, wide of mid off. He gets to the other end.
Shorter in length this time, Kohli pushes it to short mid-wicket.
Very full and VK pushes this one back down. Lyon dives to his right and stops the single.
Flatter delivery on the pads, worked away to square leg by Jinx for a single.
Flighted outside off, Rahane is down the track and pushes it back with a straight bat.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Too wide outside off, it's left alone by the Indian skipper.
Kohli has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Extra bounce. This one cuts back into the batsman from a good length around off. Virat fails to defend and is hit on the body.
Hazlewood bowls it on a driving length outside off. Kohli is not interested in accepting the proposal.
Short and on off, defended off the back foot by Kohli.
Allows the ball to spin down the leg side and nudges it towards leg gully.
Tossed up ball around middle and leg, Rahane defends it from the crease.
Gets forward and works it around off his pads. Once the short mid-wicket fielder fails to stop it with a dive, they cross for a run.
Presses forward to a full ball and presents a straight bat in defense.
Flatter and shorter on off, defended off the back foot.
Flighted delivery, around off, Kohli defends it off his front foot.
Nathan Lyon is back on.
Well outside off this time, left alone by Jinx.
Wide outside off and Rahane defends it off the back foot. We have a slight drizzle here, nothing too heavy and we go on for now.
Short ball on the off stump, Kohli just drops it on the off side and runs through to the other end. Quick single, good running!

FOUR! Flashy shot! Short delivery outside off, Kohli edges his attempted square cut and it flies away above slip and gully for four! FIFTY FOR THE SKIPPER! 20th in Tests. What an innings it has been so far! Kohli started off quickly almost like giving a statement to the bowlers that he is not here to dance on their tunes. Then slowed down and played according to the merit. Lovely batting but it is imperative for India that he continues.
Full outside off, defended on the front foot into the ground.
Fuller length outside off, pushed to cover-point by VK.

SIX! This surely is Virender Sehwag batting wearing the mask of Ajinkya Rahane. You don't see Rahane hitting biggies often even in T20 cricket. Plenty of intent shown. As soon as Starc digs in a short delivery outside off, Rahane latches onto it, stands tall inside the crease and spanks it over third man for half a dozen of runs. Great battle between bat and ball going on.
In the channel outside off, Rahane allows it through.

Full and around off, Kohli strides forward and gently pushes it in the gap at covers. He turns for the third run as the fielder doesn't quite anticipate that. A throw towards the striker's end would have been interesting. Rahane was pretty slow compared to Kohli in charging for the third run.
Angling away from the batsman, Kohli prods forward with an angled bat and pushes it to point.
Very wide outside off, Kohli allows it through to the keeper.
A length ball around off, angling away, Virat comes forward and pushes it to extra cover.
Presses forward and defends it carefully to covers.
Rahane has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Edgy! Cummins slants in a length ball around middle and off, Rahane is squared up in his stance as he tries playing it straight. It goes off the outside half of his bat to point and Ajinkya comes out of his crease in search of a run. Kohli initially shows interest but then sends him back.
Angling into the batsman from a length outside off, Rahane is on the front foot as he blocks.
That's a nice leave from Rahane. It's in the channel outside off, Ajinkya is quite assured in making that leave. This is the Jinx that we all know.
Extra bounce from a good length outside off, Rahane taps it down with a loose bottom hand to gully.
Good length delivery on middle, at 146.2 kph, Rahane just turns it from the crease to backward square leg for a run. 7 coming from this over.
Width on offer outside off, angling away, Rahane stays back and guides it past backward point for a brace.

FOUR! Eased away! Short again by Starc, on the body of Rahane who just helps it away on its way to the fine leg fence. Used the pace of the bowler to his advantage. He's showing good intent and looking to take the attack to the bowler.

Bottom edge this time. Rahane seems rattled at the moment. He needs to be extra careful. Starc bowls it shortish and around off, Rahane tries to cut but it's too close to his body. It gathers the bottom half of his bat and goes on one bounce to the keeper.
Back of a length delivery around off, Rahane goes on his toes and defends it down safely.
Double bluff to begin this over. Starc serves a wide full delivery outside off, Rahane throws his bat at it and misses. His front foot went nowhere. Probably he was expecting a short delivery.
A tad overpitched this time, Kohli scoops it slightly towards cover but the ball doesn't have enough on it to go to the fielder on the full. Kohli needs to be more careful here.
Full and outside off, Kohli prods ahead and defends it to cover.

This one is flicked away on the leg side beautifully. There is no deep square leg and the batsmen can come back for three by the time the mid-wicket fielder runs to it from inside the circle. Rahane reaches double figures.

FOUR! What a shot to play off just your seventh delivery! Banged short outside off, Rahane rocks back and plays the upper cut over point for four runs. A positive looking Rahane has come to the crease, might just work in his favor.
Slightly fuller outside off, Rahane presses forward to defend. He gets an inside edge that rolls down to mid-wicket.
Good length ball on middle, Rahane defends it showing the full face of the bat.

Starc is relentlessly targeting the rib cage. Yet another lethal short delivery, Rahane tries to pull but it probably takes the gloves and lobs in the air. Falls safely wide of leg gully. A single taken. What a probing over by Starc, a successful one too.

Rahane will fight fire with fire. As soon as Starc digs in another short ball, Rahane pulls out the horizontal bat shot from his repertoire. He stays back to wheel his bat across the line but fails to middle his shot. It takes the bottom half and loops in the air. Luckily for him, it goes safely over mid-wicket for a couple. Jinx is off the mark.
Angling away from the batsman, once again a touch short, Rahane stands back to play it down towards gully.

Paine appeals for another catch down the leg side! This time it's not given and Starc is also not interested. A shortish delivery around leg, Rahane tries working it around but misses. There is some noise which the replays later on show to be coming from the ball brushing Rahane's jersey.
Ajinkya Rahane is the number 5 batsman. India trail by 244 runs.

OUT! Starc strikes gold! Pujara has been caught down the leg side. The field was set for some short stuff as Paine had planted a short leg and a leg gully. But the wicket-taking delivery turns out to be a back of a length ball going down the leg side. Pujara tries to glance it off his hips but gets a faint edge behind to Paine. He makes no mistake, they appeal and the finger has gone up. A quick check for the no ball is also done but Mitch is fine with his landing. Australia finally succeed in breaking the 74-run partnership. A big breakthrough too as Pujara is someone who has the ability to bat for a longer period.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Paine is not learning. Still no bat-pad. Once again an inswinger catches the inside half of the Indian skipper's bat as he prods forward in defense. Balloons off the pads but falls safely behind the vacant short leg region. A fine over by Pat!

Needs to be careful, Kohli. He just cannot afford to keep flirting with deliveries outside off with an angled bat. This one whizzes past his blade. Luckily for him, didn't take any edge. It's a risky thing anyway with slips and gully waiting.
Smartly played. A little bit of width on offer outside off, Virat pushes it with an angled bat and places it through the gap between gully and slips. Two added to the total.

Five bonus runs for India! Effort delivery by Cummins. He bends his back and lets out a short delivery. It goes way over the head of the batsman and Paine has no chance of collecting it even with a jump. The umpire stretches his hands to call it a wide.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Back of a length delivery outside off, played down from the crease to point.

Where is bat-pad? Cummins gets a length delivery to move back into the batsman from a length outside off. Kohli brings down his bat in defense but it takes the inside edge, brushes his pads and lobs up in the air. No one at short leg and Kohli survives.
Angling across the batsman, outside off, Pujara allows it through to end the over.
As expected, it's banged in short, around leg, Pujara sways away from the line of fire.
Short leg in, leg slip also comes in. Starc switches to over the wicket. Short stuff coming up???
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Identical to the first delivery of this over. Starc angles in a length ball, targeting the off pole, Pujara covers the line and defends it from the middle of his blade. Rock solid.
Lands it on a length outside off, a hint of movement there as it hits the deck, Pujara first covers the line and then shoulders arms.
Starc continues with his 'round the wicket angle for Pujara. He darts it in around off, on a length, Che blocks it quite solidly.
And again. Kohli is not at all interested in chasing anything outside his off stump. One more leave to end a good over.
Serves it on a good length and in the region outside off, a watchful Indian skipper has nothing to do with it.
Cummins is too straight and full with his line and length this time. Pujara eases it off his pads to fine leg for one.

TOO HIGH! Cummins with a delivery which nips back in from a good length around off. Pujara with a static footwork tries to defend it from the crease but is beaten for pace, probably. He is thudded on the pads, they appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Paine has a chat with his bowler and goes for the DRS. The replays roll in and they find it to be heading over the sticks. The point of impact was clearly telling the story. It was always going over. Australia lose a review.
Shout for an lbw! Not given and Australia have reviewed it. Height factor?
Better this time by Che. He watches the line closely and offers a straight bat after pressing forward.
Movement and extra bounce. Ouch. Pujara takes a blow near his ribs as he fails to keep it out from the crease. It's a lively surface and quite demanding. You need to be right on the money every ball.
Yet another leave to end the over as the final ball is well outside off. Good patience here from an innately attacking player.
Another leave from the skipper as the ball rises from a short length outside off.
Outside off and on a good length, VK lets it go through to Tim Paine.
Slightly short of a length and Kohli is solid in defense.
This ball was on off stump and Kohli leaves it. The ball shapes back in after landing but the bounce carries it over the stumps. Good leave in the end, one can say.
Short ball outside off, still rising as it passes Kohli. Left alone by the batsman.

Fuller ball on middle and leg, Kohli looks to play it fine on the leg side. He gets an inside edge as the ball comes in slightly after landing. The batsmen run through for one and the skipper keeps strike.
Outside off on a shorter length, Virat shoulders his arms to let that one through.
Fuller in length, Kohli drives this straight back down but straight back at Cummins.
Length ball outside off, Kohli chooses to leave it alone.
Much better from the Indian skipper, he remains in his crease and defends this short ball on off stump.
Outside off and Kohli is drawn into the drive. The ball moves away a bit after landing and misses the outside edge by inches. A collective ooohzz by the fielders and the crowd.
Cummins to bowl from the other end.
Wide outside off to finish the over, CP raises his arms again as he lets it go.
Closer to the off stump on this occasion, Pujara stands tall and defends it.
Well outside off again and left alone again by the man bred and brought up for Test cricket.
Around the wicket to Pujara, the ball is short and outside off. Pujara lets this one go through.
Full and wide outside off, chased by Kohli. It goes in the gap to the left of point. The ball doesn't reach the fence but the batsmen come back for three.
Short ball to start off with, Kohli jumps and fends this one off.
Welcome back, the players and umpires are back on the field. Starc to begin and Kohli to face.
... Day 2, Session 3 ...

An attritional session of Test match cricket. Started positively for the Aussies as they got the wicket of KL Rahul. The ball was being made to do all sorts of funny things by the pacers. But then Kohli took the center stage. He met fire with fire and looked positive from the outset. He was ably supported by his 'Man Friday', Cheteshwar Pujara. They both have endured a tough session where neither was run-scoring easy nor was surviving. They did have a bit of luck but the fact of the matter is that they are not out. It is imperative for them to continue if India are to reach anywhere close to the Australian total. Will the two pillars of the Indian team hold strong or will the Aussies be able to bring it down? We will see in the last session which will begin in a while. Stay tuned with us.
Pujara takes a step down the track and defends it comfortably on the leg side. THAT WILL BE TEA ON DAY 2. INDIA 70 for the loss of two wickets after 32 overs.
Pujara takes a huge stride forward and dead-bats this one.
Flatter and going down leg, the skipper works it fine on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Beautiful drive from Kohli. India's first boundary after 130 deliveries. Full delivery outside off, Virat comes ahead and drives it through the covers. Races away to the fence.
Flatter delivery turning down leg, Kohli misses the flick and gets hit on the pad. A loud appeal but very optimistic.
Lyon to bowl what should be the last over before Tea. Starts off with a full and flat one outside off, Kohli comes ahead and pushes it to mid-wicket.
Very full and on middle and leg, Che flicks it away through the gap square on the leg side for a couple.
Effort ball on middle and leg, Pujara is quick to duck under it and lets the ball go through.
Fuller ball on off stump, CP comes forward and plays it into the ground on the off side.
Another ball outside off and left alone again.
Well outside off and well left too by the batsman.
Shorter length ball on the pads, Pujara works it away to deep backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Flatter delivery outside off, Kohli defends it off the back foot.
Fuller and outside off, Pujara gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it to long on for a single.
Shorter ball on the pads, flicked away to the square leg fielder.
Fuller delivery on off and the batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it to mid-wicket.
Shorter and Kohli immediately rocks back and plays it to the right of short-leg again with soft hands. The batsmen run through for a single.
Flatter delivery on middle, Kohli is ahead and plays it with soft hands.
Fuller length ball on off, Pujara defends it into the ground coming half-ahead.
An effort delivery from Hazlewood, the ball comes in with the angle and is aimed at the head of the batsman. CP has his eyes on the ball all along and sways out of the way.
On off stump and just short of a length, Pujara defends it from within the crease.
Slightly short of a length here, Pujara trusts the bounce and lets the ball fly above his off stump and to the keeper.
Another ball outside off and left alone. Tim collects it above his head and looks around as if to suggest that he likes the carry.
Outside off and on a good length, Pujara lets the ball go through to Paine.
Well outside off to end the over, the skipper lets it go through.
Another looped delivery outside off, Virat drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Full ball on off and middle, Kohli pushes it off the front foot to mid-wicket.

50-run stand! Full ball on middle, Pujara comes down the track and whips it away behind square on the leg side for three runs. Also brings up the half century stand between these two. Has been a fighting one. This is also the 12th occasion this pair has been involved in a fifty stand in Tests to go with the six century partnerships.
Worked away fine on the leg side for a single.
Flatter delivery on middle, Kohli is on his back foot and pushes it to mid-wicket.
On a length and top of off stump, Pujara is in his crease and defends it towards mid on. A loud no follows.
Fuller ball on off and middle, Kohli comes ahead and tries to push this one straight back. He gets the inner half of the bat and the ball runs down to fine leg for a single.
Bouncer on middle, Kohli ducks and lets it fly through.
Just short of a good length, the ball straightens after landing. Kohli closes the face of the bat a bit early and gets the leading edge to cover. Luckily, it is all along the ground.
On a good length and outside off, Virat leaves it alone.
Good length ball on off stump, Kohli defends it by coming well ahead.
Another ball outside off, Pujara pads it away. Lobs on the off side and there are calls of 'catch it' from the close-in fielders.
Well outside off and the batsman offers no stroke on this occasion.
Pujara takes a step or two down the track and pads this one away.
Very flat ball on middle and turns enough to be collected down leg by Paine. Pujara was looking to flick it but misses it completely as the revolutions on the ball were too many.
Shorter in length and CP pushes it to mid on off the back foot.
Flatter delivery on middle, Pujara plays it to short leg with soft hands.
Overpitched and driven to mid off. No run.

Ooooh! Almost had him! The ball is outside off and the Indian skipper is drawn forward into a drive. Just beats the outside edge and goes to the keeper. He now has a grin on his face. Realizes it was a very good ball.
Closer to off stump now, Virat has to play at this one and defends it into the ground coming forward.
Outside off and fuller on this occasion, Kohli takes a big stride forward before letting it go.
Shorter in length and well outside off, the skipper shoulders his arms.
Edged! But drops well short of second slip. Good length ball to which Kohli prods ahead and plays with soft hands. It takes the edge but doesn't carry.
Shorter and flatter delivery to end the over, Pujara pushes it to short mid-wicket.
Another back foot defense from CP keeping the ball on the off stump line out.
Flatter ball on middle, Pujara defends from within the crease.
Well outside off, Pujara checks the line of the ball and leaves it alone.

Fuller outside off, Pujara looks to flick it away on the leg side after coming down the track. He misses and the ball goes to silly point. Pujara is quick to get back into the crease. Meanwhile Lyon appeals alone for an LBW but the umpire says no.
Flatter ball outside off, Kohli pushes it down to long on and gets to the other end.
Well outside off again, CP lets it go through to Tim. Third leave in a row, good disciplined batting.
Outside off on a length and the ball shapes in after landing, Pujara shoulders his arms to it.
Shorter and wide outside off, Pujara lets it go.
This time he gets this good length ball away on the offside. He just looks to time it and gets it through the covers. The batsmen pick up three by the time the ball comes back.
A half-volley outside off, Kohli is unable to time his drive and the ball goes straight to wide mid off.
Shorter ball outside off, Kohli rises with the ball and ensures he keeps it down towards point.
Josh Hazlewood is back into the attack.
The batsman charges down the wicket once more and pushes this flatter delivery to mid on.

Fuller delivery outside off, Pujara is quick with his feet as he comes down the track and drives this. It seems to be going towards long off but Lyon dives to his left and makes an amazing one-handed stop. That's brilliant fielding on the followthrough.
An extra close-in fielder coming in. Peter Handscomb is placed at silly point.
Flatter delivery again, CP stays back in his crease and keeps it out.
Pujara comes down the track to this flatter one but gets hit on the pad. The ball lobs into the offside.
Pujara will feel he has missed out here. It was short outside off and the batsman cuts it away but is unlucky as the ball goes straight to the fielder.
Flatter delivery on middle and leg, Kohli works this away to square leg quite easily for a run. It brings up the 50 for the visitors.
Good length ball on off stump to end the over, he defends it coming half-ahead. Made a good sound as it came off the bat.
Outside off and on a good length, Pujara plays this with soft hands towards gully.
Shorter ball aimed at the batsman's head, Kohli swivels and pulls it away to deep backward square leg for a single.
Shorter length outside off, left alone by Virat.
Much better from the skipper as he presents the full face of the bat to the length ball outside off this time.
Inside edge onto the pads! The ball lands fuller and on off, jags in a little after landing. Kohli who is trying to push at this, gets an inside edge that goes onto the pads.
Flatter delivery to end the over. The batsman remains in his crease and defends it off his back foot.
A flighted delivery outside off, Pujara comes down the track and defends it with his pad.
Another very full ball, Kohli whips it all along the ground to long on for a single.
Fuller this time and Kohli drives it beautifully on the front foot through the off side. It is straight to the cover fielder but it is a much better shot from the skipper.
Outside off and Kohli looks to play it with the spin and work it through the leg side. But he gets a leading edge that lands just short of the point fielder. Very encouraging for the off spinner.
Flatter ball landing on off and turns a bit, Pujara works it away to square leg for a run.

Nearly takes the outside edge. Once again a delivery which straightens after pitching just outside off catches Kohli pushing inside the line. The Indian skipper has to be careful. Probing over by Pat Cummins.
Again slightly short and angling in, Virat stays back to block it on the leg side.
Back of a length delivery on off, defended off the back foot to covers.
A touch short and in the region outside off, Virat stands back and shoulders arms.
Beaten! Unplayable delivery. Cummins lands it on a length close to the off stump line. Kohli leans forward in defense but it straightens off the seam to beat the outside edge.
Initiates the over by serving a full length delivery on middle and leg, Pujara picks it up off his pads and flicks it nicely to deep mid-wicket for three runs. Nice use of the wrists by Che.

Well bowled! Kohli is drawn forward into the drive and the full ball outside off goes straight to point. That is exactly what Lyon and his skipper would want. Maiden over and a very good one from the off-spinner.

Good punch down the ground by Virat to this flatter one outside off. The short mid-wicket fielder comes around and dives to ensure that there is no run there. Applause from his teammates and the crowd.
Another delivery that lands on off, Virat defends this one solidly.
Flatter delivery on middle, Kohli stays on his back foot and punches it back down.
So close again! Kohli looks to flick this flatter delivery on his pads. Falls just short of the short-leg fielder.

Oohhh...that missed the off pole by a whisker! Look at the smile on Lyon's face, he knows that he nearly got the Indian skipper there. Outside off to start off with, Kohli decides to leave this one. The ball turns in sharply and bounces a large amount as well. That's what has saved Kohli here. Just a whisker away from the off stump. There is a wide grin on Lyon's face. The ball has spun a long way there.

Drinks break. The first hour after the Lunch break has been an intriguing one. Hazlewood wasted no time in shattering Rahul's stumps but since then Virat Kohli and Cheteshwar Pujara have formed an alliance. The Indian skipper has looked in ominous touch on a testing surface, thereby displaying his true class. His partner has been solid as well but there are odd deliveries causing issues to the batsmen. It's a demanding deck and a batsman is never in. Need to keep concentrating hard.
Alters his length this time and fires in a fuller length ball in line of the stumps. Pujara immediately presses forward and presents a straight bat in defense.
Back of a length delivery just outside off, Pujara stays back-footed inside the crease and defends it right under his watchful eyes.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Outside edge! Just drops short of third slip. Good ball on off, Pujara looks to defend, gets an outside edge but does well to remove his lower hand off the handle. The ball doesn't carry to third slip.
This time it's a tad fuller and Kohli works it away off the front foot to fine leg and runs to the other end.
Shorter ball on the hips this time, Kohli flicks it away towards fine leg for a couple. Given as leg byes, maybe no bat then.
Similar ball to the last one and similarly punched to cover by the batsman. No run.
Shorter length this time, Pujara rocks back and punches it towards cover.
Flatter delivery outside off, Che is well ahead as he defends it into the ground.
Outside off and a little flight on this, Pujara takes two steps and pads it away.
Quicker delivery on middle, Pujara rocks back and defends with a straight bat.
Flatter delivery on the pads, Kohli works it away to deep square leg for a single.

Snorter! The ball is on a good length and rares up in the end to beat the outside edge of Pujara who was half-ahead trying to defend this one. Paine goes up in an appeal as he seems to have heard something. Cummins says that he didn't hear anything. The Australians have a discussion and then decide not to review. Good decision in hindsight as there was no edge there. Pujara is lucky not to get an outside edge on that. Good end to the over.
Slightly slower ball outside off, Kohli places it in the gap towards cover-point and gets a single. A run after 28 balls. It's been a quiet phase of play for the Indians.
Good yorker! The captain is up to the task though as he digs it out towards mid on with a straight bat.
Fuller ball outside off, Virat drives it on the front foot to mid off.
Shorter outside off this time, Kohli looks to pincer the gap between the slip cordon and gully but is unable to do so.
Very full and on off stump, Virat uses his wrists to flick it. Mid on dives and stops any run.
Fuller outside off, he comes ahead and dead-bats it into the ground.
Another one that is on off and middle, Pujara is down the track and works it to short mid-wicket again.
Slightly slower, the batsman works it to short mid-wicket.
Another ball on middle and off, Pujara moves back and defends it well.
Flatter ball outside off again, Pujara is ahead and defends it towards backward point.
Flatter delivery outside off, Pujara rocks back to defend with a straight bat.
Nathan Lyon is now into the attack.
Another maiden over. The last ball is slightly full and outside off, defended well by Kohli towards the off side.
A good length ball that the skipper decides to defend from within his crease.
Very full this time, Virat times his straight drive to perfection but Pat is quick to go down and stop it. Would have been a certain boundary if it had gone through.
Good length ball outside off, Kohli is well ahead trying to push this through the covers. Gets a thick edge that goes to gully.
Bouncer that is going down leg, Kohli was initially looking to pull it but then decides to let it go through to Tim.
Good ball just short of a length on off stump, Kohli stands tall and defends it towards cover.
Shorter ball outside off, Pujara watches it all the way into Paine's gloves. Second maiden on the trot.
Very full ball on off stump, Pujara drives it down the ground but straight to mid off.
Outside off and on a length, left alone by the batsman. The ball thuds into the gloves of Paine at shoulder height.
Bouncer on middle, Pujara ducks under it and lets it go through.
And just as we say he looks solid in defense, he gets an outside edge to a length ball on off stump that goes on the bounce to gully. Good ball from Hazlewood.
Shorter length ball on top of off stump, Pujara looks solid in defense.
Short length ball outside off to which Kohli shoulders his arms. Good start by Cummins.
Good length ball outside off, Kohli is ahead to it but shoulders his arms and lets it through.
Another short of a length delivery which the captain defends from within the crease.
Shorter in length and Virat jumps slightly to defend the ball towards point.
Outside off and left alone by the skipper this time.
Fuller outside off to start with, Virat comes ahead and defends it off his front foot.
Pat Cummins is the first change in bowling for the Aussies.
Short and aimed at the hips on this occasion, Virat works it away to fine leg for a single. Retains the strike. 13 runs off the over.
He brings his length to a good one outside off. Kohli gets a thick edge to gully. It was all along the ground.
