FOUR! Woahh! Another sublime looking shot. Comes back to the fuller length after just one ball and Kohli pounces on it like a hungry tiger. Flicks it away beautifully to the mid-wicket fence to get the third boundary in the over. What will Josh do now?
Shortens his length outside off, Kohli is nimble on his toes and defends it into the pitch.
FOUR! On the offside this time. Full and outside off, Kohli is well ahead and leans into this off drive. The fielder at mid off dives to his right but can't reach it. Two in two for the skipper.
FOUR! Overpitched and easy pickings for Kohli! Too full and on middle, the captain uses his wrists to flick it away in front of square on the leg side and all the way for four runs.
Fuller and down the leg side now, CP nudges it down fine on the leg side and comes back for an easy two.

Down the leg side and short of a length. Pujara tries to run it down fine but misses it and the ball takes his shirt as it goes through. Paine collects it and appeals, but there is no interest either from the umpire or from the bowler.
What a contest this! Not much one can do about such a delivery! Outside off, draws the batsman forward to defend and just tails away in the end to beat the outside edge. Good bowling!
FOUR! Too full this time and Pujara strokes it away beautifully through the covers for a boundary. It was a teaser for Head who gives it chase but the ball just has enough on it to reach the fence.
Pujara is riding his luck here! Tentative prod outside off to this fuller one. Just skims past his outside edge.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Pujara defends from within his crease.
Short and well outside off, Kohli leaves it alone.

Very full on this occasion, trying too hard to get the swing it seems. It is worked off the pads by Pujara using his wrists. The batsmen come back for three runs as the ball stops just inside the fence.
Fuller this time and on off, the batsman comes well ahead and dead bats the ball before it swings.

JUST SHORT! A genuine nick is induced by a peach of a delivery from Josh. It lands on middle and squares Pujara up. The ball goes off the outside edge and lands just in front of Shaun Marsh at first slip. Almost had his man there.
The ball is well outside off, easy leave for the batsman.
Oooh! Extra bounce there! The ball is on a length and straightens after landing on off, Pujara looks to defend with soft hands but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.
Too full and on the pads, Pujara flicks it away to fine leg and gets to the other end, keeping strike.
Bouncer on the off stump line, he sways out of the way and evades it.
Going down the leg side now, Pujara leaves it alone.
A shade closer to the off pole on this occasion, Che covers his off stump and lets it go through once again.
Well outside off and on a short length, Pujara shoulders his arms and lets this one fly through.
No ball! Starc has overstepped again here, bowls this one outside off on a length and Pujara lets it go through as the ball straightens a bit.
Way too wide outside off and Pujara is not even thinking about playing at that.
Good length ball just outside off, Kohli defends it towards point.
Shorter outside off, left alone by VK.
Immediately the length is shortened and Virat rocks back to guide this one in the gap between slips and gully. The ball doesn't reach the fence but the batsmen come back for two.

FOUR! What a shot! Fuller length ball on middle but Kohli being Kohli, doesn't defend and goes for the positive approach as he on drives this past mid on for four runs. Looked real good on the replays too.
A very confident looking defensive stroke from the skipper on his first ball as he takes two strides ahead and defends this length ball on off stump.
Virat Kohli is in at no. 4.

OUT! Cleaned him all ends up! Rahul plays all around a pretty straight one and gets bowled. The ball was very full, almost yorker length. It seams through the air and Rahul completely misjudges the line of the ball. Plays for the middle and leg line and the ball lands on off and he is cleaned up. Has a look of disbelief on his face as he walks back. Brilliant bowling from the hosts. Both the openers back in the pavilion cheaply.
Almost a similar ball to the Vijay dismissal but this is just slightly more at the pads. Rahul flicks it away fine and retains strike for the next over with a single.
Shorter one on off and coming in a tad bit, Rahul gauges the bounce and shoulders his arms to it.
Outside off on a length and the ball holds its line. Rahul leaves it alone.
Slightly shortens his length and on the pads, worked away to fine leg and Pujara is off the mark with a single.
Good length and outside off, ball straightens after landing. Cheteshwar chooses to leave it alone.
Full ball coming in late and Starc seems to be finding his rhythm, could mean danger for India. Pujara deals with this one well as he defends it on his front foot.
Mitchell Starc to continue from the other end.
Another one outside off and left alone. Maiden over to start the second session.
Short of a length and outside off, he lets it go through.
Good bouncer outside off to follow up on the full ball, KL ducks under it and sways away.
Slightly overpitched and sliding down the leg side, the batsman misses his flick and gets rapped low on the pads. But the ball was well down leg and hence, there in not much of an appeal.
Fuller and on off stump, Rahul is lucky as he gets an inside edge onto his pads while trying to defend on the front foot.
Lovely shape first up, Rahul is half forward in defense and plays it towards cover-point.

The players and umpires are making their way back to the middle. Pujara comes in at no. 3 for India and is at the non-striker's end. Rahul will face the first ball of the post-Lunch session from Hazlewood.
... Day 2, Session 2 ...

What a session for the Aussies! The Indians had their tail up when they got the last 4 wickets of the hosts for 16 runs. But they have been quickly quietened in the third over of their innings. They have lost their 'Monk', and are 6 for the loss of 1. This wicket would give Mitchell Starc a lot of confidence following his not-so-inspirational performance at Adelaide for which he has received a lot of flak. India's best batsman in the first Test, Cheteshwar Pujara and KL Rahul have a lot of work on their hand when they come back in the 2nd session. Can they build a partnership or will the Aussie pacers be too hot to handle? Join us for the post-Lunch session in some time.

OUT! Bowled 'em! There's the first one! A huge gap between bat and pad and the timber is disturbed. A Starc special here, as this one lands on middle and tails in after landing. A loose, loose shot from the opener, quite late in bringing his bat down and the ball knocks his middle stump after brushing the back pad on its way through. It is the sixth time Starc has got Vijay in Tests and the third time this series in as many innings. Just the start the hosts would have wanted and exactly not what the Indians would have liked. THAT WILL ALSO BE LUNCH ON DAY 2.
Sliding down the leg side on this occasion, Vijay misses his run down and gets hit on the pad on its way through. Paine collects its well down the leg side.
Well outside off on a good length, not too much inswing and Murali lets it go comfortably.
Shorter in length and Vijay is on his toes as he defends it with soft hands onto the pitch.
No ball! Starc has overstepped here. The ball is full and outside off, Vijay lets it go through.
Full and well outside off, Vijay shoulders his arms to it.
Full and on middle and leg, Rahul nudges it fine down the leg side for a single.
A peach to end the over! Slightly fuller and Vijay tries to defend coming forward. The ball tails away late and beats the outside edge.
Much better from the batsman as he gets right behind the line of the ball and defends it well.

So close to the outside edge! Starting just outside off and slightly short of a length, Vijay tries to defend on the back foot but is late in bringing his bat down. The ball whizzes past the outside edge and to Tim behind the wickets.
Short and just outside off, Vijay stands tall and defends the ball from within the crease.
Another ball that is angling down the pads, Murali keeps the ball down on the leg side.

Four leg byes! The first ball from Josh is angling down at the pads and hits Vijay on the pads as he tries to guide it down to fine leg. The ball runs all the way to the fence and India are off the mark.
Josh Hazlewood to share the new ball.
Another delivery which has been served in the region outside off. So far it has gone on with the angle of the left-armer without much movement. Rahul allows it through to end the first over safely.
Much better. A delivery in the zone outside off, Rahul watches the line closely and then lets it through to the keeper.

Nearly an outside edge! A needless shot. Rahul is tempted into the drive as Starc dishes out a full away swinging delivery. Respecting the early conditions and the new ball will be the key. You just cannot go around fishing. Application is paramount.
Goes full this time, targeting middle and off stumps, Rahul is half forward again as he blocks it solidly.
Another delivery which has been hurled in the channel outside off, not much movement, Rahul covers the line and shoulders arms. Needs to be watchful, KL!
Starc speeds in from over the wicket and angles across a good length delivery outside off. Rahul is half forward with his bat near his front pad as he makes a leave.
